newsitem.title: ITALY: IBM says not interested in Olivetti PCs.
newsitem.headline: IBM says not interested in Olivetti PCs.

text.p: U.S. computer giant IBM said it is not currently interested in taking over the loss-making personal computer business of struggling Italian information technology group Olivetti

"In business affairs one can never say never. If the right opportunity presents itself we might think about it but for now there is no contact," the chairman of IBM Europe Lucio Stanca told reporters at an international conference at this northern Italian lakeside resort.

Olivetti's PC business lost 200 billion lire in 1995 and some 10 billion lire in the first half of 1996, but Olivetti chief executive Francesco Caio has said that Olivetti would continue to streamline its PCs business and has not said directly that the company was looking to sell it.
